provenance.title: Classification of connected étale algebras in pre-modular fusion categories up to rank three

candidates.statement: There does not exist a pre-modular fusion category with fusion ring K(psu(2)5) and trivial conformal dimension. In other words, all pre-modular fusion categories with fu- sion ring K(psu(2)5) are modular.
candidates.proof_excerpt: Assume the opposite, and suppose there exist pre-MFCs with trivial conformal dimensions obeying the fusion ring K(psu(2)5). When conformal dimensions are trivial, they turn out to be symmetric. For a symmetric fusion category B, there exists a ﬁnite group G such that B ≃Rep(G) [3
